units.source_text: 原来世间无论何事，都是实行不及预想之美。

en.t: In this world, whatever the matter may be, the reality of carrying it out never proves as beautiful as one imagined.

units.source_text: 源氏公子的脾气正是如此：他对于顽强不屈的人，恋慕特别深切。

en.t: Prince Genji's temperament was just like this: toward someone stubborn and unyielding, his longing grew especially deep.

units.source_text: 他想：“槿姬不许我求爱，但每逢机会，总不惜向我表示风趣。

en.t: He thought, "Princess Asagao will not allow me to court her, yet whenever there is an opportunity, she never hesitates to show me her wit and charm.

units.source_text: 这证明对此人是可以互通真情的。

en.t: This proves that with this woman it is possible to exchange true feelings.

units.source_text: 倘过分多情，惹人注目，反而会暴露多余的缺陷。

en.t: If one becomes excessively amorous and draws people's attention, it will instead expose needless flaws.

units.source_text: 我不愿把西殿里那个人养成这种性情。”

en.t: I do not wish to bring up the person in the western wing to have such a disposition."

units.source_text: 他推想紫姬近日一定寂寞无聊，思念之心，无时或息。

en.t: He imagined that Lady Murasaki must lately be lonely and bored, and that her longing for him never rested for a moment.

units.source_text: 但也只觉得是关怀一个无母的孤儿，并不担心她像情人一般因久别而怀恨。

en.t: Yet he felt only that he was caring for a motherless orphan, and did not worry that she would resent his long absence as a lover might.
This was truly a pleasing state of affairs.
